topic.title: Why Criticism Sticks and Praise Doesn't

copy.kicker: The wound writes louder than the win.
copy.thumb_scene: Wick stands upright on a plain white studio background, one hand pressed flat against his chest over his heart, the other hand loosely open at his side letting something invisible slip through his fingers, a crumpled note in his chest-hand and a clean gold ribbon on the floor near his feet already fallen.
copy.send_to: the friend who replays one bad review and forgets ten good ones
